mines.mine_notes: Development-stage open pit gold project (Koné + Gbongogo deposits). Under construction in FY2025: on-budget, 3,000+ workforce, 9.0M+ hours worked; CIL tanks erected/hydro-tested; oxide sizer complete (4 months ahead of schedule); ball mill shells installed (Jan 2026); ~$104.7M capex in Q4 2025 with ~$418.0M remaining to first gold pour. Government of Côte d'Ivoire holds 10% free carried interest. Streams: Zijin 3.1% of payable gold until 54,000 oz delivered, then 1.3% LOM (pays 20% of spot); Wheaton 19.5% until 400,000 oz, then 10.8% until +130,000 oz, then 5.4% LOM (price-adjusted mechanism, first 5 yrs). Triple Flag 2.0% NSR on Koné permit. No production in FY2025. Reserve table not restated in annual report (fields null).

notes: FY2025 annual report/MD&A used (year ended December 31, 2025). Development-stage company: no operating mines, no production, no revenue from mining. Montage also holds 19.5% of Sanu and 9.9% of Aurum (equity investments, not mine rows). All amounts in USD unless noted.
